title: Practice 3: Two verbs for every way of going

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Ты ___ (ехать — to go by vehicle, ride, one way) в Рио на Олимпиаду?
exercises.why: The expression "to go by …" (means of transportation) is rendered in Russian by на + prepositional case: ехать на поезде (на автобусе, на автомобиле), лететь на самолёте. — DLI, Lessons 19–20.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: Are you coming to Rio for the Olympics?
exercises.context: The expression "to go by …" (means of transportation) is rendered in Russian by на + prepositional case: ехать на поезде (на автобусе, на автомобиле), лететь на самолёте.

exercises.q: Над водой ___ (летать — to fly, there and back or in general) чайки.
exercises.why: Летать: this verb belongs to the 1st (Е) type of conjugation. я — иду́ — хожу́ — е́ду — е́зжу — лечу́ — лета́ю. ты — идёшь — хо́дишь — е́дешь — е́здишь — лети́шь — лета́ешь. он, она — идёт — хо́дит — е́дет — е́здит — лети́т — лета́ет. мы — идём — хо́дим — е́дем — е́здим — лети́м — лета́ем. вы — идёте — хо́дите — е́дете — е́здите — лети́те — лета́ете. они — иду́т — хо́дят — е́дут — е́здят — летя́т — лета́ют. — DLI, Lesson 22.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: Seagulls fly over the water.
exercises.context: Летать: this verb belongs to the 1st (Е) type of conjugation.

exercises.q: Я часто ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general) в Лондон.
exercises.why: However each action of going (to go on foot, to ride, to fly) is expressed in Russian by two parallel verbs: one for the function A — being on the way to … — иду, еду, лечу; another for the function B — usually, often, etc. to go to … (the motion to and from is understood) — хожу, езжу, летаю. *Капитан идёт в штаб. Капитан едет в город. Капитан летит в Вашингтон.* — DLI, Lesson 22.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: I often go to London.
exercises.context: However each action of going (to go on foot, to ride, to fly) is expressed in Russian by two parallel verbs: one for the function A — being on the way to … — иду, еду, лечу; another for the function B — usually, often, etc.…
